Ravi: ok small Friday experiment: I asked an LLM to write a dramatic resignation letter from the perspective of the office stapler. peak content. :stapler:

Ravi: ```Dear Colleagues, I can no longer bind myself to the endless tide of TPS reports and sticky-notes. My spring is tired, my teeth are dulled by low-quality staples, and I dream of a quiet drawer where I may click calmly into sunset. I leave you with this single, unassuming staple: remember to organize your docs. Farewell, Stapler.```

Nora: hahahaha the stapler has better emotional arcs than my last three merges :joy:

Zoe: prompt please, I need to riff on this and make a sonnet-version for the printer.

Ravi: Prompt: ```Write a short, dramatic resignation letter from the perspective of an office stapler. Keep it witty and a little tragic.```

Ava: helper-bot, can you schedule a "Stapler Send-off" at 3pm? We should ceremonially oil it and feed it premium staples. @helper-bot

helper-bot: @Ava Created event "Stapler Send-off & Premium Staples" for Friday 3:00 PM. Reminder set.

Zoe: challenge: next time make the stapler write a breakup breakup text to the hole punch. I want passive-aggressive hardware romance.

Nora: agreed. Also someone actually refill the staples before the send-off pls. This is getting emotional.

Ravi: noted. ceremonial staples and tissues on standby. :tissue:
